entities.summary: Lyudmila Chernyshova is a Russian former volleyball player who competed for the now defunct Soviet Union. Born in Moscow, she competed for the Soviet national team at the 1976 and 1980 Summer Olympics. She won a gold medal in the 1980 Olympics in Moscow.
